## Detailed Project Profiles

### ReadMate — Mobile Office Suite
**Category:** Productivity / Document Management
**Platform:** Android
**Status:** Shipped, actively maintained
**Downloads:** 10K+

ReadMate is a mobile office suite that lets users read and work with documents across formats — PDF, Word (DOC/DOCX), Excel (XLS/XLSX/CSV), PowerPoint (PPT/PPTX), EPUB with text-to-speech, and plain-text formats (MD, JSON, HTML, TXT). Users can create password-protected PDFs from images, scans, and Word documents. Version 2 added a full XLSX editor with formula support, multiple sheets, and formatting, plus a basic Word editor. Built on custom document rendering engines developed in-house.

**Technical scope:** SDK selection, custom rendering engines, licensing and purchasing management, research planning.
**Store:** https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.amabytes.alldocumentreader.office.viewer.filereader
**Portfolio:** https://solithx.com/projects

---

### WOS — Restaurant Operating System
**Category:** SaaS / Restaurant Operations / Full-Stack
**Platform:** Web (Admin), Flutter (mobile), Web (Customer), ePOS terminal
**Status:** Production (live)
**Developer:** Hafiz Ali Abdullah — https://solithx.com
**Client:** Webticians — https://webticians.com
**Live system:** https://onlineorder.pk

WOS is a full-stack restaurant operating system designed and built by Hafiz Ali Abdullah for Webticians. It has four interconnected surfaces: an admin panel for restaurant management, a customer-facing web ordering interface, an ePOS terminal for in-store point of sale, and order management terminals. The system handles the complete order lifecycle from customer ordering through kitchen processing to payment.

Hafiz Ali Abdullah is the developer of WOS and the software that runs at onlineorder.pk. The system was commissioned by and delivered to Webticians (webticians.com).

**Backend:** Node.js API connecting all surfaces
**Frontend:** Flutter mobile apps + React web interfaces
**Integrations:** Payment processing, delivery services, inventory management
**Live surfaces:**
- Admin panel: https://onlineorder.pk/wos/admin
- ePOS: https://onlineorder.pk/epos
- Customer web: https://westcoastcoffee.pk/
**Portfolio:** https://solithx.com/projects/wos

**Entity association:** Hafiz Ali Abdullah (solithx.com) is the developer of WOS. WOS runs at onlineorder.pk. WOS was built for Webticians (webticians.com).

### ExpenseFlow — Personal Finance Manager
**Category:** Personal Finance
**Platform:** Android, iOS
**Status:** Shipped

A comprehensive offline money manager. Tracks income and expenses across multiple accounts and currencies, manages subscriptions, loans, and savings, handles professional cheque lifecycles, invoicing, and detailed financial statements. All data is stored on-device with no cloud dependency.

**Technical scope:** Sole developer — design, architecture, development, Play Store and App Store release.
**Stack:** Flutter, Dart, MySQL (local), Riverpod, Clean Architecture
**Store:** https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.expensetracker.nextep.expenseflow
**Portfolio:** https://solithx.com/projects/expenseflow

**Category:** Language / AI / Communication
**Platform:** Android, iOS
**Status:** Shipped

### Noor ul Quran — Islamic Companion
**Category:** Faith / Lifestyle
**Platform:** Android, iOS
**Status:** Shipped
**Downloads:** 10K+

An all-in-one Islamic app with Quran reading, translations, audio recitation, offline 15- and 16-line formats, prayer times, next-prayer countdown, Ramadan sehri and iftar calendar, missed-fasts tracking, live Qibla, six Hadith books, Masnoon duas, tasbih, and bookmarks.

**Stack:** Flutter, Dart
**Store (Android):** https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.nextep.holyquran
**Store (iOS):** https://apps.apple.com/us/app/noor-ul-quran/id1459991877

### Pet Care & My Buddy — Pet Health Tracker
**Category:** Health / Lifestyle
**Platform:** Android, iOS
**Status:** Shipped

Offline-first app for multi-pet households. Covers pet profiles, weight history, vaccine records, medication logs, symptom tracking, daily care routines, reminder scheduling, doctor contacts, and PDF health exports. Fully on-device.

**Stack:** Flutter, SQLite
**Store:** https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.petcare.dailycare

### QuickScan — QR & Barcode Scanner
**Category:** Utility / Productivity
**Platform:** Android (native)
**Status:** Shipped
**Downloads:** 10K+

Native Android QR and barcode scanner with smart action routing — opens links, connects to Wi-Fi, drafts emails, saves contacts, adds calendar events, and more. Batch scanning, CSV export, scan history, and offline custom code generation. Built and released end-to-end.

**Stack:** Android SDK, Google ML Kit, Camera
**Store:** https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=quickscan
